Privacy

How Faith Life handles information when you visit this website or get in touch with us.

Who we are

This website belongs to Faith Life Community Ministries, 427 Matheson Avenue, Winnipeg, Manitoba R2V 3A7.

For a privacy question, a request about your information, or a concern about a photograph, contact our church leadership through the contact page, or write to us at the address above marked “Privacy”.

What you share with us

The contact form asks for your name, email address, a subject and your message. Your phone number is optional.

We use this only to reply to you and to arrange any follow-up you ask for, such as joining Growth Track or a Bible study. Sending a message does not add you to a mailing list.

Please don’t send financial details, identification documents, or confidential counselling or medical information through the form. Ask us about a better way to talk about sensitive matters.

Where your message goes

The form sends your message to the church’s contact service on flcmonline.com, which runs on WordPress. Messages are checked for spam by Akismet, a service of Automattic, before they reach us.

Only the people at Faith Life who answer messages can read them. We keep messages for as long as we need them to respond and follow up, then delete them.

Cookies and embedded content

This website does not set cookies of its own, and it does not use analytics, advertising or tracking tools.

Two things on the site are provided by other companies. When they load, those companies may receive your IP address and browser details and may set their own cookies:

  • The Spotify player on the homepage and the Messages page (Spotify’s privacy policy)
  • The Google map on the Contact page (Google’s privacy policy)

You can manage or delete those cookies in your browser settings. The links to Facebook and Google Maps directions don’t load anything until you follow them.

If you use the “Pause animations” button in the footer, your browser remembers that choice on your device. It is not sent to us.

Hosting

Like every website, this one is delivered by a hosting provider that processes routine technical information, such as your IP address, to deliver and protect the site. This version is hosted on GitHub Pages, and GitHub’s privacy statement explains what it logs.

Photos

Photos of our church family appear on this website with the consent of the people in them. If you would like a photo of you or your child removed, let us know through the contact page and we will take it down.

Your choices

You can ask to see the information you have sent us, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Contact us through the contact page.

We may update this page when the website or our practices change. Last updated November 2026.
